signals.title: USD/CAD — Geopolitical De-escalation + COT Short Squeeze
signals.text: CAD COT LF short -49.1k (28.1% long, 19th percentile) faces acute short-covering pressure as weekend progress on an Iranian diplomatic framework softens crude oil prices below $92.40/bbl. The 158bp OIS carry advantage backing USD (SOFR 3.88% vs CORRA 2.30%) anchors upside momentum after USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4141 cleanly above its 20-day SMA at 1.3927. The next BoC meeting (mkt: 66% hike priced) on 28 Oct determines policy divergence, but prompt energy-spread deflation leads the move. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CAD on spot open targeting 1.4200 extension. Catalyst: Crude oil open reaction to the 7-day Strait of Hormuz resolution proposal. Risk: Iranian diplomatic negotiations collapse, driving WTI back toward recent cycle highs.

signals.title: USD/CHF — SNB Policy Reassurance vs Extreme Carry Gap
signals.text: CHF COT LF short -18.6k (7th percentile, z=-1.54) caps franc appreciation despite SNB Chairman Schlegel dismissing recent CHF weakness as a temporary pause in long-term structural strength. The crushing 400bp policy rate spread and negative SARON (-0.0400%) relative to SOFR (3.8800%) penalize unhedged CHF longs, keeping USD/CHF elevated after Friday's close at 0.8283 above all major daily moving averages. The next SNB meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 10 Dec acts as the definitive policy checkpoint, but retail's 68% short bias leaves the topside vulnerable to drift. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CHF on dips toward 0.8250 backed by massive positive carry. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo liquidity resumption following Schlegel remarks. Risk: SNB steps into spot markets with direct FX sales to halt franc depreciation.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Options Downside Skew vs 290bp Carry Floor
signals.text: USD/JPY 25-delta risk reversals print at -2.28 alongside a -1.6% volatility risk premium (IV 8.7% vs HV30 10.3%), showing heavy demand for downside protection despite the pair closing Friday at 157.19. The dominant 290bp OIS carry buffer (SOFR 3.88% vs TONA 0.98%) directly clashes with this derivative-market skew, generating a tactical squeeze floor around the 20-day SMA at 156.40. The BoJ Monetary Policy Meeting Minutes at 23:50 UTC serve as the immediate test of tightening intent ahead of the next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 30 Oct. Trade bias: Neutral-to-bullish USD/JPY above 156.40 as deep carry limits sustained declines. Catalyst: BoJ Monetary Policy Meeting Minutes release at 23:50 UTC. Risk: BoJ Minutes reveal explicit consensus for an imminent October rate hike.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Crowded Speculative Shorts Facing Technical Resistance
signals.text: EUR COT LF short -58.8k (37.3% long, 27th percentile) leaves the pair vulnerable to short covering after Friday's close at 1.1401 stabilized just above structural multi-month lows. Disjointed ECB commentary and an adverse 144bp OIS carry differential (SOFR 3.88% vs €STR 2.44%) maintain structural selling into rallies toward the 20-day SMA at 1.1539. Multiple ECB President Lagarde addresses on Monday establish the policy threshold ahead of the next ECB meeting (mkt: 45% hike priced) on 29 Oct. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD on corrective rallies into 1.1480-1.1520. Catalyst: ECB President Lagarde speech at 13:30 UTC Monday. Risk: ECB explicitly pre-commits to a 50bp rate hike at the October meeting.
